GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   D. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

3. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   D. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   C. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

8. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   B. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Industry as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   C. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   C. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   C. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.

13. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

14. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   C. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.

15. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.

16. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
